text:
Amira Khan: Welcome Mei Chen, joining Monday as Director of Observability 🎉. Mei will own observability strategy across Runtime + Dedicated.
Mei Chen: Excited to join the team! Looking forward to meeting everyone.
Tomas Rivera: Welcome Mei! Quick logistics Q: which oncall rotations will you inherit initially?
Amira Khan: Short plan: Mei will shadow Samir for 2 weeks on incident rotations, then take over strategic oncall ownership. No immediate changes to oncall headcount.
Samir Patel: Happy to run shadowing. I'll hand over runbook highlights and the incident postmortem template. Planning a 1hr handoff Tue 3pm.
Zoe Kim: Recruiter note : congrats! We'll open a req for "Senior Observability Engineer" to backfill one of Mei's IC bits. Posting the JD to #jobs in 30m. Nora is recruiting lead.
Nora Elbaz: On it. Please post 3 outcomes and must-have vs nice-to-have in a reply so I can prioritize sourcing.
Tomas Rivera: Mei 8b, can you share 1-2 priorities for your first 30 days so teams know what to focus on?
Mei Chen: Sure: 1) stabilize alert noise by tuning thresholds, 2) audit critical dashboards and add ownership tags, 3) set a plan for cross-region tracing coverage.
Amira Khan: Onboarding details: buddy = Tomas, access = runtime-observability slack + infra docs, first week meeting schedule will be posted in your calendar.
Zoe Kim: Hiring timeline for the IC backfill: 3-stage loop (screen, technical case, cross-func panel) target 4 weeks. Drop referrals or internal candidates ASAP.
Nora Elbaz: Candidate bar note: must-have SRE/observability + Prometheus/Grafana experience. Nice-to-have: distributed tracing systems, model-serving metrics.
Samir Patel: Ops note: I'll add a short "handoff checklist" to the runbook with entries: rotate keys, update alert owners, add new dashboards to onboarding.
Amira Khan: FAQ to reduce pings: 1) comp changes? No immediate changes. 2) Does this create new headcount? Yes, one IC req for backfill. 3) Questions? Reply here or DM People Ops.
Mei Chen: Thanks all . I'll post a short intro doc (background + 30/60/90) to the shared drive and do 15-min intro hops with each team next week.
Tomas Rivera: Welcome aboard Mei 389. Looking forward to the handoff sync Tue.
Nora Elbaz: Posting the JD and recruiter tracker now. Will ping for referrals.
